subject: Chroma Consulting: implementation run-through & cutover checklist
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@chroma.consulting>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@chroma.consulting>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: run-through for Redwood integration + materials attached

Hi Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demos last week. Chroma is eager to move from PoC to a supported production deployment and we'd like to run a focused implementation rehearsal next week to validate the reference design and cutover approach.

Attachments: chroma-redwood-ref-design-v1.pdf (pdf), redwood-chroma-test-matrix.csv (csv)

High-level asks for the run-through: 
- Walk through the reference architecture and exact network requirements (VPC peering, egress rules).
- Validate authentication flows (SSO/OIDC + API key fallback).
- Execute the test matrix on a staging stack (token limits, failing-over to backup model).
- Confirm monitoring/alerting hooks and log forwarding.

Proposed participants from our side: myself (integration lead), Tom (security lead), and an infra engineer if possible. We prefer Wed or Thu next week, morning PT.

Please let us know your availability and any prerequisites. We also attached a short network access doc with IP ranges and ports.

Sara
Sara Patel
Director, Integrations | Chroma Consulting
[sara.patel@chroma.consulting]

---
Replying to schedule and prep items will help us scope a short mutual action plan (MAP).

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@chroma.consulting>, Tom Briggs <t.briggs@chroma.consulting>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: run-through for Redwood integration + materials attached

Sara — thanks for the clear note and the attachments.

We can run the rehearsal on Thursday 2026-10-08 10:00AM PT. Agenda suggestion (60-75m):
1) 10m — Introductions & goals for cutover
2) 15m — Reference architecture walkthrough (network, auth, routing policies) — Karthik to lead
3) 20m — Live test matrix run (staging) — Marissa to orchestrate
4) 10m — Observability & alerting checks, SLO expectations
5) 5-10m — Blockers, next steps, action items (DocuSign SOW / timeline)

Pre-reqs from Redwood:
- We will provide a sandbox endpoint in us-west-2 and temporary API keys.
- Karthik will share a short runbook with commands and expected responses.
- Please confirm the infra engineer who will run the staging tests.

We also need SOC2 evidence for Chroma's security questionnaire items related to data handling before we start production-only tests. If that will be slow, we can scope the rehearsal to staging-only items that don't require production data.

I've attached an initial test-case mapping below and included the Confluence link to our playbook.

Attachments: redwood-chroma-test-matrix.csv (csv)
Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PARTNERS/Chroma+Implementation+Playbook

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: run-through for Redwood integration + materials attached

Thanks, Jonas — Thursday works for our team. We can have our infra engineer (Daniel Cho) on the call to run the staging test cases.

Quick clarifications: 
- For SSO we plan to use Okta (OIDC) with a short-lived token exchange. We need to confirm the redirect URI and the JWKS endpoint details.
- For private deployments, Chroma will require a plan for KMS integration (customer-managed keys) — is that handled post-cutover or during pilot?
- We attached a small network-access-instructions.txt file with IP ranges and a recommended NAT configuration.

Attachments: network-access-instructions.txt (txt)

Tom also asked if Redwood can run a failover test where the primary model is throttled and traffic is routed to a lower-cost variant. That's part of our test-matrix spreadsheet but wanted to call it out.

Sara

Jonas —
I'll own the staging run and bring the test harness up on Monday so we're not provisioning last-minute on the call. Quick checklist for us:
- Confirm sandbox cluster (us-west-2) with 4 x A10G nodes
- Pre-load KV cache with the example prompts (see test-matrix csv)
- Wire up logging->S3 and temporary CloudWatch alerts for memory/cold-starts
- Prepare a short failure injection script (throttle primary model) for the failover test

I'll also create the INT-1342 ticket and drop the link in the calendar invite.

Marissa Cole
